meta.name: migrate-nanoclaw
meta.description: Extracts user customizations from a fork, generates a replayable migration guide, and upgrades to upstream by reapplying customizations on a clean base. Replaces merge-based upgrades with intent-based migration.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 fork 的自定义迁移到上游版本
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果维护着一个上游项目的 fork，想升级又不丢失自定义改动。
copy.tagline_en: Migrate fork customizations to upstream releases
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you maintain a fork of an upstream project and want to upgrade without losing custom changes.

howto.what: 这个技能会分析你对 NanoClaw 代码仓库的个性化修改，生成一份可重用的迁移指南。之后，当上游版本更新时，它会基于干净的上游代码重新应用你的所有修改，避免合并冲突。
howto.when: 当你需要将 NanoClaw 仓库升级到上游最新版本，同时保留自己的定制修改时触发。通常在你运行迁移命令或提到“升级”、“迁移”等关键词时启动。

say.text: 帮我提取我对 NanoClaw 的所有定制修改，生成迁移指南。
say.note: 技能会分析你的修改并生成指南。

say.text: 升级我的 NanoClaw 仓库到最新上游版本，保留我的定制。
say.note: 技能会使用已有指南或重新提取，然后执行升级。

say.text: 检查我的 NanoClaw 仓库是否有现成的迁移指南。
say.note: 技能会检查并告知你指南是否存在。

howto.what_en: This skill extracts your customizations from a NanoClaw fork, generates a replayable migration guide, and upgrades to the upstream version by reapplying your customizations on a clean base, avoiding merge conflicts.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to upgrade your NanoClaw fork to the latest upstream version while preserving your custom modifications. Typically starts when you run a migration command or mention 'upgrade' or 'migrate'.

say_en.text: Extract all my customizations from NanoClaw and generate a migration guide.
say_en.note: The skill will analyze your changes and create the guide.

say_en.text: Upgrade my NanoClaw repo to the latest upstream, keeping my customizations.
say_en.note: The skill will use an existing guide or re-extract, then perform the upgrade.

say_en.text: Check if there's an existing migration guide for my NanoClaw fork.
say_en.note: The skill will check and inform you if a guide exists.
